Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Pylon DBS System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 3-Tesla or less when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- head transmit/receive coil only.
- Receive with the head transmit/receive coil.
- whole body SAR not to exceed 1 W/kg.
- Maximum active scan time of 10 minutes.
Before scanning, set the device configuration: Therapy OFF.
Scan regions: Extremity scanning only (knee and below, elbow and below).
